item.title: Migrating from Cusdis to Remark42: Scraping, Self-Hosting, and Fixing CORS
item.description: Intro For a while, I’ve been using Cusdis as the comment system for my Hugo blog. It’s lightweight and privacy-friendly, but as my homelab has grown, I realized I wanted full ownership over my data and a bit more feature richness (like OAuth logins and email notifications). I decided to migrate to Remark42, a fantastic, self-hosted, lightweight comment engine written in Go. There was just one problem: Cusdis doesn’t have an “Export to Remark42” button.
